cohort: 252,447 pregnant women attending antenatal care at a tertiary care hospital in Delhi, India, between May 2002 and May 2015, of whom 243 were HIV positive.
finding: Of the infants born to HIV-positive mothers for whom follow-up data were available, three tested positive for HIV at 18 months of age.
mod_finding: Operative delivery rates declined from 50% to 31% over the study period.
